name: MCP Tools - Observability
description: Observability adapter for MCP Tools: an event subscriber that logs every MCP tool execution (started/succeeded/failed) with timing and sanitized arguments to the mcp_tools log channel.
project_description: Sub-module of MCP Tools. Subscribes to the code-wheel/mcp-events ToolExecution Started/Succeeded/Failed events dispatched by the tool dispatcher and writes structured watchdog log entries (tool name, plugin id, request id, duration, reason, sanitized arguments) to the mcp_tools logger channel.
